What is the FOURTH step in the troubleshooting methodology?
Establish a plan of action to resolve the problem and identify potential effects
What should a plan of action include?
The steps to resolve the problem and their potential effects
Why identify potential effects in the plan?
To anticipate and minimize unintended consequences of the fix
Which practice is part of establishing a plan of action?
Considering how the fix might affect other systems or users
Which element should a plan include to allow recovery?
Which practice helps when a fix requires downtime?
Scheduling a maintenance window and notifying stakeholders
Making changes during peak hours without notice
Which practice supports a good plan of action?
Breaking the solution into clear, ordered steps
Which consideration belongs in the plan for a change affecting many users?
Communication and timing to minimize disruption
Which practice helps identify potential effects of a configuration change?
Which practice helps ensure the plan can be approved if needed?
Following change management for significant changes
Which plan element addresses what to do if the fix fails?
Which practice helps minimize risk in the plan?
Making the smallest change that resolves the problem
Which practice helps the plan account for data safety?
Backing up configurations or data before changes
Which practice helps plan a fix for a core device?
Planning for redundancy or failover during the change
Which practice helps identify potential effects on security?
Checking whether the change weakens any security controls
Which practice helps plan a fix that may affect performance?
Considering the performance impact and timing
Which practice helps the plan stay realistic?
Estimating the time and resources needed
Which practice helps plan for user communication?
Informing affected users of expected downtime or changes
Which practice helps the plan address testing after the fix?
Including verification steps in the plan
Which practice helps plan a change involving multiple teams?
Coordinating with those teams before implementing
Which practice helps identify potential effects of a routing change?
Considering how it affects traffic paths and reachability
Which practice helps the plan reduce the chance of lockout?
Ensuring out-of-band access or commit-confirm during remote changes
Which practice helps plan a fix during business hours when necessary?
Weighing urgency against impact and getting approval
Which practice helps the plan account for dependencies?
Mapping which systems rely on the component being changed
Which practice helps plan a hardware replacement?
Preparing the replacement, backups, and configuration in advance
Which practice helps identify potential effects on other services?
Reviewing shared infrastructure that the fix touches
Which practice helps the plan be executable by others?
Which practice helps plan for verifying the fix worked?
Which practice helps plan a change that could affect compliance?
Which practice helps the plan minimize blast radius?
Scoping the change to only the affected component
Which practice helps plan for a change that may require a reboot?
Scheduling the reboot and informing users
Which practice helps identify potential effects on monitoring?
Considering whether the change affects alerts or visibility
Which practice helps the plan prepare for escalation?
Identifying who to contact if the fix exceeds your scope
Which practice helps plan a fix that touches DNS or DHCP?
Considering the impact on name resolution and addressing for all clients
Which practice helps the plan account for time-of-day effects?
Choosing a low-impact time for the change
Which practice helps plan for a firmware upgrade?
Reviewing release notes and planning a rollback
Which practice helps the plan include stakeholders' needs?
Confirming acceptable maintenance windows with the business
Which practice helps plan for verifying no new problems arise?
Including checks of related systems after the fix
Which practice helps the plan be safe for a live network?
Including reversible steps and monitoring during the change
Which practice helps plan a change with potential security effects?
Reviewing firewall rules, ACLs, and access after the change
Which practice helps the plan prepare materials in advance?
Gathering needed tools, configs, and credentials beforehand
Which practice helps plan a fix for an intermittent issue?
Including a way to confirm the fix during the problem conditions
Which practice helps identify potential effects of disabling a service?
Checking what depends on that service first
Which practice helps the plan reduce user frustration?
Which practice helps plan for a change requiring coordination with an ISP?
Scheduling with the provider and confirming the maintenance window
Which practice helps the plan be auditable?
Documenting the planned steps and approvals
Which practice helps plan a fix that could affect backups?
Ensuring backup jobs are considered in the timing
Which practice helps the plan handle unexpected results?
Defining decision points and when to roll back
Which BEST summarizes the plan-of-action step?
Create ordered steps to resolve the problem, anticipate effects, and include rollback and communication
Which practice ensures the plan supports the next step?
Making the plan clear enough to implement or escalate
